address: Rue du Try Bara 33, Ohain, 1380, Belgium
bio: The view over the rolling hills of Lasne cannot fail but draw your eye as you take a seat in this contemporary eatery. Designer and authentic details have been cleverly mixed in this characterful edifice. The tables on the patio are taken by storm whenever the weather permits. Connoisseurs of exceptional ingredients can now devote their attention to the culinary treats crafted by Benjamin Laborie, whose opulent menu features delicacies such as porcini, seabass and venison from Ardennes.The chef’s talent for spot-on cooking is on a par with the world’s master chefs and he enhances carefully sourced produce by delicate creative touches.
